THIS IS THE FIRST AENEIS REGION EVER REGISTERED. The manifest currently

as was done when Historia stopped being the MOX track.
al1 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al1), so its numbers
mirror the l2/l3 blocks in rules.php, not a fabulae duel: no combat, a
generous clock, two phases (transitus + sententia).
Legacy single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 10 / 95 s; the real
phases are transitus hp 5 / 45 s and sententia hp 5 / 50 s. bossMinMs
15000 matches the floor the integrator applied to l2 and l3.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as r03/r04/l3: rules.php
stores {q, a} — the question word and the vocab key that must be picked
— so grading never depends on the order the client drew the options in;
`correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz order in content/aeneis-al1.js.
For a word -> pick-the-image quiz the answer IS the question word.
al1 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
*** FILE NAME — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING. The content file is
content/aeneis-al1.js, NOT content/aeneis-l1.js as the illustration in
content/README.md §0 has it (that line was written before any Aeneis
region existed). Two constraints force it and they point the same way:
1. js/content-loader.js derives the path as content/<track>-<region>.js,
so the file name is the region id, not the liber number; and
2. server/lib/rules.php keys regions in a FLAT GLOBAL namespace —
rule_regions() writes $out[$id] across ALL tracks — and 'l1'/'l2'
already belong to Historia Sacra (rule_regions_builtin()). A region
id of 'l1' on the aeneis track would MERGE with Historia's Liber I:
one entry, two capitula lists, wrong track.
Hence region id 'al1' and file aeneis-al1.js. Suggested follow-up for the
integrator (NOT done here, it is a shared file): correct the example line
in content/README.md to content/aeneis-al1.js. ***
XP is set one step above Historia's because an Aeneis capitulum is the
longest unit in the product (16–21 story pages against Historia's 12–14)
and the track is explicitly for prōvectī. Integrator: harmonise if the
curve matters more than the signal.
